description: World energy outlook enerdata is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Climate, Energy efficiency", published or maintained by Enerdata (Enerdata). Eneroutlook provides global energy and climate scenarios at global or region level Global Energy Outlook (EnerOutlook) is a free online interactive data software, allowing to browse data through intuitive maps and graphs, for a visual analysis of the expected long-term trends in the energy industry. These can be viewed globally and by world region. Coverage: 6 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 1 file in HTML. The portal files it under Climate, Energy efficiency. The portal gives 2023 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
